title: CORE-7108 · [RF] SITEWIDE: body base font is Inter 16px/24px on clone (live is Myriad 18px/27px)
body:
Linear: https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7108/rf-sitewide-body-base-font-is-inter-16px24px-on-clone-live-is-myriad

(Reference only — the ticket is the source of truth; fetch the live description at implement time.)

---

## ⛔ PLANNING RECONCILIATION — 2026-09-04

**⚠️ QA FAILED 2026-09-01 — this is a rework round, and it carries a trap. Read all of this before touching anything.**

**The QA FAIL comment (Erin Bolas, verbatim):**

> **QA Result: FAIL**
>
> **Design QA:** Re-tested the `body` font fix (headless, 1800px, `getComputedStyle` post-`document.fonts.ready`) on all pages listed in this ticket's confirmation history, plus `/help-centre/online-admin-portal/`. All 12 pages still compute `Inter, "Inter Fallback"` / 16px / 24px — none show the DoD target (`myriad-pro-semi-condensed` / 18px / 27px).
>
> Tested: `/faqs`, `/faqs/company-secretary`, `/faqs/self-assessment`, `/faqs/the-formation-process`, `/faqs/vat`, `/id-requirements`, `/additional-services/business-address`, `/additional-services/london-registered-office`, `/additional-services/service-address`, `/contact-us`, `/environmental-policy`, `/help-centre/online-admin-portal`.
>
> **Remaining Issues:** Fix not observed on any tested page — not a partial rollout, uniform failure across the full confirmation list. No PR is attached to this ticket, unlike comparable Ready for QA tickets.
>
> **Validation:** 12/12 pages fail.

### ⛔ THE TRAP — this fix is expected to move ZERO visible pixels

A prior full investigation (legacy task T35, now retired; report `reports/T35-CORE-7108-verification.md`) proved the premise is **true at the `<body>` element but that nothing inherits it**:

| | live | clone |
|---|---|---|
| `<body>` font-family | `myriad-pro-semi-condensed, verdana-fallback, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif` | `Inter, "Inter Fallback"` |
| `<body>` size / line-height | **18px / 27px** | **16px / 24px** |

But every visible text-bearing element outside header/footer/nav resolves to **Myriad at 100% on BOTH sites** — measured across live `/` and clone `/` at 1440 and 360, plus `/privacy-policy`, `/id-requirements`, `/site-map` and `/a-z-glossary-of-terms` (rich-text-heavy pages chosen deliberately as the likeliest place for a missed opt-in — there is none). Size distributions match, and the two shared homepage headings are identical on both sites (36px/44.46px w400 at 1440 and 360). Face resolution was proved by canvas fingerprinting against 11 candidate families: live `<body>` renders 468.79px for a fixed sample and `myriad-pro-semi-condensed` measures **468.79px exactly**; every other candidate is 22–214px away.

**So: satisfy the literal DoD on `<body>`, and do NOT restyle rendered text to manufacture a visible difference.** There is no visible defect to chase. A change that moves rendered text is a regression, not a fix.

### Not a licensing matter

Myriad is already licensed and wired: `layout.tsx` injects the Adobe Typekit kit gated on `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADOBE_FONT_PROJECT_ID` (`wrj3hpa` in `.env`), and the local build emits the Typekit `<link>`. Since QA measured 12/12 failing on the **deployed** clone while local emits the link, suspect the deployed build/env before the source.
acceptanceCriteria: `<body>` computes `myriad-pro-semi-condensed` / 18px / 27px on all 12 pages named in the QA FAIL comment.

Measured on the DEPLOYED clone (not a local build) and the report states explicitly where — the prior round failed because the change was never observable in the deployed build, and no PR is attached to the ticket at all.

ZERO change to rendered text: every visible text-bearing element outside header/footer/nav still resolves to Myriad at the same size/line-height as before, on at least `/`, `/privacy-policy` and `/a-z-glossary-of-terms` at 1440 and 360. A visible diff here is a regression.

Assert the Adobe Typekit `<link>` (gated on `NEXT_PUBLIC_ADOBE_FONT_PROJECT_ID=wrj3hpa`) is present in the DEPLOYED HTML — ideally as a CI assertion, since local emits it but the deployed pages failed 12/12.
Open a PR and attach it to CORE-7108.
